newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OSCE's Vranitzky to visit Albania on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: OSCE's Vranitzky to visit Albania on Sunday.

text.p: European envoy Franz Vranitzky will pay a one-day visit to Albania on Sunday to check on preparations for general elections due later this month, a spokeswoman for the Vienna-based OSCE said.

Former Austrian chancellor Vranitzky will meet local officials from the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe to discuss the June 29 vote. He will also hold talks with President Sali Berisha, Prime Minister Bashkim Fino and leaders of the main political parties.
"This will be a one-day visit aimed at keeping up the momentum in the election process," the spokeswoman said.
Albania is looking to the parliamentary elections to reestablish normalcy after months of violent unrest, sparked by the collapse of fraudulent savings schemes earlier this year.
